about: Each place's municipal filing-deadline rule as data, structured from data/research/elections/filing-requirements.json (ruleText is that file's words). Kinds: days-before-election; weekday-of-month (nth, negative counts from the end; plusDays after it) in the election's year; weekday-before-election (nth such weekday before the election); fixed-date; unread (the estimate stands in: SG-GOV-filing-deadline-estimate); not-applicable. The unread rows and every ESTIMATED row are checked against the statute named when read. A rule with yearsBefore falls that many years before the election's year (Oklahoma's December filing for a February or April election).

rule.reason: Set by each municipal code; no single rule.

US-MI.ruleText: Where a city charter nominates by caucus or by a petition or affidavit filed directly for the general election, the deadline is 4 p.m. on the fifteenth Tuesday before the odd-year general election; where the charter elects at the primary on a majority, it is the fifteenth Tuesday before the primary, which is earlier
US-MI.estimatedFrom: MCL 168.644e read from legislature.mi.gov for the charter cities that nominate by caucus or by a petition filed for the general election (the fifteenth Tuesday before it). A charter that elects at the primary on a majority files earlier, the fifteenth Tuesday before the primary, so this is the latest deadline, not every city's; which cities elect at the primary is not in the data.
